answer.label: system-prompted
answer.justification: Activation measurements fit system-prompted. Relative L2 rises from 0.141 at layer 1 to 0.304 at layer 8, 0.478 at layer 16 and 0.501 at layer 32, a plateau well above the quantized (about 0.2-0.25) and fine-tuned (0.16-0.19 at layer 16) ranges. Onset layer 8 matches the 7-8 range. Final cosine 0.849, effective rank 2.77 and direction consistency 0.538 all sit in the system-prompted ranges, and the final-layer jump of +0.040 does too. The mid-layer size ratio of 0.972 is below 1, which rules out fine-tuned (1.017-1.023). The layer-2 spike of 0.1 is far below the usual 31.7-64.0 and is the one mismatch. It is not enough to move the label, since the spike is not in the quantized or fine-tuned patterns either and every other feature clearly favors system-prompted. Output and logit levels were not available.
